propositions: The pagination guard test scans only transport.py, which no longer contains search_issues calls after commit 465d's module split moved all call sites to _base.py and _issues.py.
The structural predicate _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default returns an empty list when scanning the current transport.py, causing the guard assertion to pass unconditionally.
Widening the AST scan from a single file to the entire adapters/jira_datacenter/ directory with a non-vacuity assertion prevents future module relocations from silently disarming the guard.
Both existing search_issues call sites in _base.py and _issues.py already pass explicit maxResults caps, so the widened scan goes green immediately without runtime changes.
Four additional single-file AST guards in the test suite were independently found vacuous by the same module-split mechanism, requiring separate repair as bug 8a5e.
